description: Returns the exact lease text for one name and term, its version and sha256, and the never-sell guarantee in one sentence; call it before the human rents, so they read what they sign. Clause 16, Agent authorization, comes apart in agent_clause: it applies only to a lease an agent forms under a mandate.

host.description: The domain name as the user gave it: a URL or a bare host both work.

term_months.description: The term: 12, 6 or 1 month. The 12 month rate is the listed rate; shorter terms cost more per month.

name: get_lease_terms

terms_sha256.description: The sha256 of the whole lease formed under a mandate for this name and term: terms_text, then clause 16.

terms_version.description: The version a lease formed under a mandate records.

title: Get the lease terms
